messages:
sophia: ok that closing ukulele + tiny hat combo is officially the highlight. who made the hat?? :tophat:
li: it was my partner's knitting emergency project, i present the tiny trilby of destiny :yarn:
derek: shoutout to everyone who brought a plant. the Bonsai Brigade has entered the chat. :deciduous_tree::seedling:
maya: my bonsai is a diva and refused to face camera angles. high production values though.
ravi: snack table report: banana bread success, but someone absconded with the mini muffins labeled 'for execs'  (mystery snack thief)
kevin: @ravi we will find them. for science. also +1 to banana bread. :banana:
all-hands-bot: recording uploaded to Drive: https://drive.example.com/all-hands/1765439999.mp4 :movie_camera:
sophia: quick non-binding poll: favorite micro-moment? a) hat b) tiny drum riff c) plants d) accidental pet cameo
li: pet cameo was my cat walking across my keyboard during Q&A. iconic. :cat2:
derek: voting plants. also proposing a future theme: "desk vignettes" where we each show one weird desk object. stakes: bragging rights + sticker
maya: desk vignette entry: vintage moon lamp, slightly suspicious.
ravi: i nominate kevin for the leading role in the next all-hands intro sequence. he has the energy. :raised_hands:
kevin: i will accept on behalf of my succulent. i will also demand a tiny cape for it.
sophia: fun fact: applause noise in the recording registers as a tiny spike in the office ambient mic, data scientists are amused.
kevin: can we get a transcript of the two best lines so i can frame them at my desk?
all-hands-bot: transcript attached: https://drive.example.com/all-hands/1765439999.txt
li: favorite quote nomination: "we ship features and occasionally hats." 

maya: also, plant care PSA: don't overwater the bonsai between all-hands and demo day. learned that the hard way.
derek: follow-up: next all-hands we should have a 60s spotlight for a pet or plant. tiny prizes.
sophia: agreed. awarding virtual confetti now. :confetti_ball::tada:
kevin: logging off with my plant cape idea. good night folks!
